notes.title: Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39772218/0952198638c3f0ed66a5d08b38689683e77bbbb5.png[/img]

The new Unreal Engine 5.0 early access released last week. Do you think I care that it might be an early access release with issues? Heck no!

I upgraded Let It Flow to the new game engine ASAP. And with it, the brand new dynamic lighting renderer called Lumen. Will you notice a major difference in the lighting? Probably not.

But will you lose some FPS?

Yes!

Enjoy!

- Jeff

notes.title: 1.2: Raw Dawg Is Here! And a Grenade Launcher.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39772218/4b8bc510bb25ad72db71ec7594e1fe0cdf4385cf.png[/img]

Patch 1.2 is here!

And with it comes a new competitor: RAW DAWG!

Be on the look out for this dangerous hot dog-like creature who have may have been a bad experience gone wrong... I mean, that's what my chat said so I'm just passing on the info. I didn't come up with it. Or make it. But I DID make all the animations for him which I'm kinda proud of not gonna lie.

Anyway, we also have a new map that's still very much in progress: E1M2! If you've played shooters from the 90's, you might recognize this classic. It's perfect for deathmatch so give it a go.

Dust Poo has also been given a visual update. Jump in there for some fun deathmatching. Future updates will add a team bomb defusal mode because why not? That is what chat wants after all.

I also fixed some bugs that people have reported.

Oh, and I added a grenade launcher as well. Go blow stuff up.

- DevAddict

notes.title: Moopy Enters The Fray!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39772218/f5542202ae45655da6a1bdbc8bd3b1a0d7460c09.png[/img]

notes.title: Here's What's Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39772218/ec273fa8f3ee60a1ef451caf6d5086d18930ac7c.png[/img]

Thanks for checking out the game! I've been fixing bugs and issues that have been popping up all weekend that I wasn't able to find during development. It's the nature of multiplayer game development, which is really hard especially for a one-man team.

So here's what my community has been working on that is coming soon:

[list]
[*] New Characters
[*] New Maps
[*] New Gamemodes
[/list]

The game will continue to improve over the coming days and weeks with frequent patches, which I'm sure you've noticed.

If you would like to make suggestions, just leave them in the discussions, or come on over to my Youtube channel and leave a comment.

[b]There will be 1-2 weekly live streams on YOUTUBE, not Twitch, adding new content.[/b] Subscribe to my channel to be notified when the streams go live.

Thanks for playing and stop by every now and then to see the progress!

- Jeff (DevAddict)

notes.title: Let It Flow 1.0 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
Well chat, we did it! We created a multiplayer game from scratch in 5 weeks. Sweet!

But we ain't done yet. Oh no! This is just the beginning.

You've already made more characters, more maps, more gamemode ideas, etc. So there is plenty more to come!

Expect lots of hotfixes for the next several days as we uncover bugs that weren't discovered during our live streaming 5 week development cycle.

The plan is to have 2 content patches per month.

[b]If you would like to contribute to the game and create stuff for it, be sure to subscribe to my Youtube channel so you can be notified when the development streams go live. And, you can get access to the Discord channel to add your stuff.
[/b]
You can make maps, characters, special effects, sounds, music, etc.

This is YOUR game. I am just a slave putting your beautiful creations to good use.

- DevAddict
